13:30 lunch (time not given, approximated): Mi Casa Vietnamese-style cucumber/chicken noodle salad — same order as 15/16 Jul, reusing that estimate.
16:00 green apple, 1 medium (~180g) — same reference as prior green-apple entries.

Dinner logged from description (no photo) at 18:25: 2 Agami Pita Pro spelt pitas (verified reference) + 200g meatballs in red/tomato sauce (estimate, no recipe given) + 4 spoons homemade matbucha (same per-spoon rate as yesterday) + a small dark chocolate praline. Meatball sauce and matbucha both tomato-based — added a modest lycopene/vitamin C/folate contribution (meatball sauce ~4mg lycopene, matbucha ~12mg) on top of this morning's tomatoes.
status_note: Slept ~4.67h (01:50-06:30) — a short night, well below the 7-9h target band. Espresso at 08:05, breakfast at 08:15 (yellow cheese + cherry tomatoes), another espresso at 09:40, lunch at 13:30 (Mi Casa cucumber/chicken salad, same as before), a third espresso at 14:00, a green apple at 16:00, and dinner at 18:25 (2 protein spelt pitas, meatballs in red sauce, homemade matbucha, a small dark chocolate praline) — 3 caffeine shots today; tomatoes/matbucha driving lycopene/vitamin C/folate.
